recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a woman standing in shallow water against a vibrant sunset. The subject wears a sheer, white, wet-look garment that catches cool blue highlights, contrasting with the warm orange and pink sky. A soft-focus mist or spray appears on the left, while a white railing pierces the horizon on the right, creating a balanced but asymmetrical background.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sunset sky vs. cool blue highlights on the subject
Soft, diffused lighting on skin vs. sharp reflections in the water
Vertical subject posture vs. horizontal horizon line and railing
coreInvariants: Sheer white fabric with visible wet texture
Soft, glowing skin tones with subtle blue rim lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium shot from mid-thigh up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, positioned in the upper-middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the curve of the arm and torso to the water, then sweeps across the horizon line to the railing.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky in the upper half and water in the lower right provide breathing room for the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sunset tones (Peach, Orange, Pink) in the background sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool Cyan and Sky Blue highlights on the clothing and water reflections.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Indigo in the shadows of the water and hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky; high value (brightness) on the subject's clothing; medium value on the skin.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks; use deep blues for shadows.
Limit greens and yellows to maintain the pink/orange/blue harmony.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the primary name
Italicized, fluid script for the secondary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular graphic element replacing or surrounding a specific vowel in the title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a wide-tracked serif and a tight, slanted script.
graphicDevices: Circular halo/ring around a specific letter in the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, thin-stroke 90s serif aesthetic.
Matches the fluid, handwritten feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-quality photograph of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a sheer white wet shirt, standing in calm water at sunset. The sky should be a vibrant orange and pink gradient. Include a white wooden railing on a pier in the background to the right and soft mist on the left. Apply a cool blue rim light to the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase text at the very top. On the left, use a light serif font with wide tracking in cyan. On the right, use a yellow italic script font. Place a small blue ring around the letter 'o' in the right-hand text.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a vibrant orange/pink gradient?
Does the clothing have a wet, sheer texture with blue highlights?
Is the text placed at the top edge with wide tracking?
Is the overall mood serene and ethereal?

adjustableVariables: Amount of mist/spray on the left
Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Avoid any specific artist names or brand logos
Ensure the circular graphic is a generic geometric shape
postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between the cyan text and blue highlights on the shirt.
Ensure the subject's skin tone looks natural under the mixed lighting.
Verify the horizon line is straight.
Confirm the text does not overlap the subject's head.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation sunset backdrop with a cool-toned, wet-textured subject and minimalist, wide-tracked top-aligned typography.
